subject: Intermittent meter heartbeat drops affecting mid-hour billing — evidence bundle & replay request
messages:
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acmecloud.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acmecloud.com
Date: 2028-04-19T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden mid-hour usage drops — possible marketplace heartbeat loss (logs attached)

Hi Stephanie,

Over the last 48 hours we've observed repeated short-duration drops in reported usage for several SKUs on the marketplace (primarily GCP and AWS listings). The pattern is consistent: a ~2–5 minute window at the top of the hour where your meter events stop arriving to our ingestion pipeline, then resume. That creates underreported hourly buckets which is now showing up as a material variance on our April invoices.

Attached: ingest-log-snapshot-20280419.csv (a 10-min sample from our ingestion tier). We think this is a heartbeat / agent-side window alignment issue, but we need Redwood's replay and a consolidated reconciliation file to move forward.

Can your team provide: 1) Redwood ingest traces that cover 2028-04-18 22:40 -> 2028-04-19 02:30 UTC (UTC window), 2) any agent-side heartbeat/seq logs, and 3) a proposed replay window and estimated delta to the invoice if replayed?

Our finance team has paused the disputed portion of the invoice pending evidence. Please treat this as urgent — if we don't get a resolution before month-end we will escalate for a formal credit memo.

Thanks,
Sam Turner
Sr. Technical Operations Manager
AcmeCloud

Attachment: ingest-log-snapshot-20280419.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden mid-hour usage drops — possible marketplace heartbeat loss (logs attached)

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and the sample. We're pulling everything now.

Jonas, Marissa — looping you both in to collect the full traces and start an internal replay plan. Priority: gather Redwood agent traces (kv/cache events, heartbeat timestamps), serving runtime ingest logs, and the routing/queue timestamps that show delivery to the marketplace connector.

Sam, we'll confirm an expected ETA for a first-pass replay within 8 business hours. If this looks like an upstream provider gap we will ask AcmeCloud to provide the provider-side ingestion id/timestamps (helps match events).

Stephanie Nguyen
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden mid-hour usage drops — possible marketplace heartbeat loss (logs attached)

Quick initial findings from a 4-hour sample (local ingestion window):
- We see a repeating TTL/flush boundary at HH:00 where the internal consumer checkpoint moved forward before the outbound push finished; outbound push timeouts coincide with the 2–5 minute gaps Sam noted.
- Meter-heartbeat-trace-04-19.json attached — contains consumer offsets, send attempts, and retry markers for affected containers.
- Hypothesis: a transient spike in queue latency + our connector batch flusher hitting the top-of-hour boundary causes some events to be excluded from the final aggregated hourly file sent to the marketplace.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Run a local replay for the window 2028-04-18T22:50:00Z -> 2028-04-19T02:10:00Z (should capture the repeated gaps).
2) Produce a reconciliation CSV that maps Redwood event_id -> marketplace event_id (when available) and tokenized usage counts per hour.
3) Ask AcmeCloud to share provider-heartbeat logs for the same UTC window so we can cross-correlate sequence ids.

I can run the replay now if we have permission to push the replay packages to the staging marketplace connector.

Jonas Weber
Senior Integrations Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachment: meter-heartbeat-trace-04-19.json (JSON, 128KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acmecloud.com>, billing@acmecloud.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T12:42:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence bundle and temporary hold on disputed invoice lines

Sam — attaching the initial evidence bundle and proposed replay package. We've also flagged the disputed invoice lines in our system and are ready to produce an adjusted statement pending replay results.

What we are sending you now:
- replay-packages/replay-request-20280419.zip (contains event payloads + replay manifest)
- ingest-log-snapshot-20280419.csv (your sample + extended window)
- meter-heartbeat-trace-04-19.json (Redwood consumer/connector traces)

Request: please confirm you can accept a controlled replay for the window Jonas recommended. Also confirm whether your accounting system requires VAT tagging info on the adjusted lines — if so, state the exact VAT codes to include so we can output them in the reconciliation.

We will place a temporary hold on the disputed invoice lines until we complete the replay and reconciliation. If the replay shows underreporting on our side, we will submit the adjustment and absorb the correction as appropriate.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: replay-packages/replay-request-20280419.zip, ingest-log-snapshot-20280419.csv, meter-heartbeat-trace-04-19.json

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, billing@acmecloud.com
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence bundle and temporary hold on disputed invoice lines

Marissa — confirmed, we received the bundle. We can accept the replay for the proposed window on our staging ingestion. I attached the provider-side logs that show the same gaps on our consumer edge: provider-heartbeat-logs-04-19.gz.

We do need the reconciliation output to include VAT tags for EU-mapped customers (code: EU-VAT-20) and a per-hour delta summary. Our billing team will review the per-hour deltas and either accept your adjustment or request a credit memo.

Note: because month-end is close, we ask Redwood to prioritize the replay and reconciliation within 24 business hours. If you need a short call with our marketplace ops team to unblock the provider IDs, we can schedule one.

Sam

Attachment: provider-heartbeat-logs-04-19.gz (GZIP, 54KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-20T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Action plan & timeline: AcmeCloud replay and reconciliation

Team — summary and owners: please treat this as high priority.

Action items:
- Jonas: run the controlled replay for 2028-04-18T22:50:00Z -> 2028-04-19T02:10:00Z against AcmeCloud staging. Produce a reconciliation CSV mapping event_id -> provider_event_id and per-hour token counts. ETA: 12 hours.
- Marissa: prepare the invoice hold paperwork and the provisional adjustment statement; include VAT tags per Sam's note (EU-VAT-20 for EU customers). ETA: 18 hours after Jonas's output.
- Monica: coordinate the customer call and confirm AcmeCloud's provider IDs are present in their logs; escalate to marketplace account team if we can't match IDs. ETA: 6 hours.

If we cannot reconcile within 24 business hours, escalate to product ops and legal for a temporary credit memo. Put BI-3421 as the canonical ticket for artifacts and drop all reconciliation files there.

I'll update Sam with the replay start time and expected delta when Jonas confirms.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
